trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

- **Diagnosis**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).
- **Rollback**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions; rollout verified.
- **Incident**: Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** describing the failure, the rollback, and a follow-up to investigate the root cause of v2.3.1 before re-deploying. The on-call engineer has been paged.
